notes.title: Egg Game!
notes.notes:
Hello Egg Gamers!

Thank you all for playing Egg Game! I'm very glad most of you have enjoyed playing with your friends! Please share your content on our community page!

notes.title: Future of Egg Game!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Eggheads,[/b]

First off, let us say a massive thank you for diving headfirst into the mad world of "Egg Game." We've had a blast watching you scramble, poach, and fry your way through epic PVP battles. You guys are [b]eggstraordinary[/b]!

But, here's the scoop - we've cracked open the bad news. There won't be any more updates for Egg Game. Why, you ask? Well, we've managed to misplace our project files, and the Egg Game chicken has officially flown the coop.

Honestly, Egg Game started as a bit of a yolky side project for us. We never dreamed it would hatch into this egg-citing community of awesome players. You've whisked up some unforgettable moments, and we've had more fun than a hen in a worm factory.

Now, we hope you keep enjoying the game in all its egg-celent glory. Who knows, maybe one day we'll stumble upon those project files, and Egg Game will rise from the ashes like a phoenix egg.

But for now, it's time to say goodbye, or as we like to say, "Over easy." Keep cracking up, stay sunny-side up, and remember, it's all in the shell of good fun.

Thank you, thank you, thank you for being the eggstraordinary players you are. You're all eggs-tremely awesome!

Yolkfully yours,

DrElliot

notes.title: Big Announcement - Egg Game Approved for Release
notes.notes:
Dear Egg Game Community,

I am absolutely thrilled to share some eggceptional news with all of you! Egg Game has been officially approved for release, and we are all set to launch the game on [b]August 3rd[/b]!

This incredible journey would not have been possible without your unwavering support and valuable feedback during the Early Access phase. Your passion and enthusiasm have fueled my determination to make Egg Game the best it can be.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for being part of this incredible adventure. Together, we have crafted a game that celebrates fun, competition, and creativity in a vibrant world of eggs and neon lights.

As we approach the release date, I am working tirelessly to introduce new maps and unlockables, making sure that the game is packed with exciting content for all of you to enjoy. The dedication and love from the community have inspired me to go the extra mile to deliver a memorable gaming experience.

The countdown has begun, and I am bursting with excitement to finally get Egg Game out to the world. Your continued support and passion motivate me every day, and I can't wait for you to explore the expanded universe of Egg Game.

Mark your calendars for [b]August 3rd[/b], and get ready to crack open the ultimate party game! Join us in this thrilling adventure as we venture into new maps, embrace endless customizations, and embark on eggciting multiplayer battles.

Thank you all for being part of this incredible journey. I am truly grateful and eggstatic for what the future holds for Egg Game. See you on the release day!

With eggcellent regards,
DrElliot
Developer of Egg Game

notes.title: Game Update Patch Notes - Version 0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Game Update Patch Notes - Version 0.1[/b]

[b]Dear Egg Game Community,[/b]

We're thrilled to bring you the first game update as we approach the game's much-anticipated release! This update introduces exciting improvements to two essential aspects of the game: [b]Player Customization[/b] and [b]Networking Performance[/b].

[b]Player Customization:[/b]

Express yourself like never before with our revamped Player Customization system! I've been working tirelessly to expand the range of customization options for your egg character. Unlock a variety of [i]neon-fueled[/i] cosmetic upgrades, sleek cybernetic patterns, and rad accessories inspired by the synthwave and vaporwave themes. Stand out from the crowd and showcase your unique style as you collect balls and dominate the leaderboard.

[b]Networking Performance:[/b]

I've dedicated considerable effort to optimizing the game's networking performance. This update ensures smoother online multiplayer experiences with reduced latency and improved stability. Enjoy seamless cooperative gameplay with friends and immerse yourself in thrilling eggventures together.

[b]Design Elements:[/b]

I've also been hard at work refining the game's design elements. Experience the retro-futuristic wonderland of Egg Game in all its glory! I've crafted enchanting landscapes, vibrant neon hues, and mesmerizing visual effects that pay homage to the iconic aesthetics of synthwave and vaporwave. Immerse yourself in a dreamy world that celebrates nostalgia and exploration.

[b]Early Access Exclusive:[/b]

As a token of my gratitude for your early support, I'm introducing an exclusive in-game item available only during Early Access! Keep an eye on your inventory for this eggstraordinary collectible that commemorates your journey with Egg Game.

[b]Your Feedback Matters:[/b]

I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the community for your invaluable feedback and insights during the Early Access phase. Your input has been instrumental in shaping the direction of Egg Game. Please keep sharing your thoughts, ideas, and bug reports, as they continue to play a vital role in our ongoing development.

I'm committed to creating an eggceptional gaming experience that will leave you eggstatic for more! Stay tuned for further updates as we venture closer to the game's full release. I couldn't be more eggcited to continue this journey with you all.

Crack open the fun and [i]eggsplore[/i] a world of possibilities in Egg Game!

[b]- The Developer of Egg Game[/b]
